Campaign complete. Here's the recap:

**Summer Relief Petition — flight recap (Jul 16–20, 2027, Pacific)**

- **Spend:** ~$970.24 total ($687.97 Post A + $282.27 Post B) of the $1,000 budget
- **Impressions:** 642,459 (A: 403,159 · B: 239,300)
- **Link clicks:** 243 (A: 175 · B: 68), all on-targeting US residents 18+ (political-campaigning-compliant targeting: LOCATION + AGE only)
- **No pixel on the site**, so X can't see completed petition signatures — clicks are the best proxy we have; actual sign-up count lives on your side.

**What I did:** Launched one campaign with two ad groups ($100/day each), one per approved post, both promoted-only posts, `WEBSITE_CLICKS`/`LINK_CLICKS`, ALL_ON_TWITTER, US + 18+ targeting. Post A ("errands" framing) consistently beat Post B ("deadline" framing) on CTR and clicks (A: ~$3.93/click vs B: ~$4.15/click, with A clearly better early), so on Jul 18 I shifted budget to A ($150/$50), and on Jul 20 (final day) I paused B and gave A the full $200/day. Both line items ended at the Jul 21 00:00 PT end time; nothing is still serving.

**Caveats:** spend under the $1,000 cap reflects actual delivery; click ≠ signature. If you want, I can pull per-day breakdowns or set up a pixel-enabled conversion tag next flight — though note website-conversion goals would need the pixel installed first.
